findings.title: Client-Side Gamification & Account Tampering in Firestore Rules
findings.impact: Students can initialize arbitrary levels and high streaks, inflate completedPomodoros, and self-delete profiles.

findings.title: Legacy Frontend Unprotected Direct AI Client Access
findings.impact: Direct @firebase/ai calls bypass Next.js server rate limits, auth verification, and system prompt guardrails.

findings.title: Node.js Timer Leak in AI Gateway Wrapper
findings.impact: Orphaned setTimeout callbacks remain in event loop on fast responses, causing memory leaks under high load.

findings.title: Header-Based Admin Key Override in Red Team Run Route
findings.impact: Allows triggering adversarial test suites in non-production environments via static header.

findings.title: High-Severity Dependency Vulnerability in js-yaml

findings.title: Storage Rules Exclude Teacher Access to Student Uploads
findings.impact: Classroom teachers are denied read access to lab reports and student homework files.

findings.title: Teacher Authorization Gap on Student Quiz Results
findings.impact: Teachers cannot inspect student quiz submissions in the teacher analytics dashboard.

findings.title: Test Suite Fidelity Boundary (Simulated vs Real Model Benchmarks)
